content.query: SELECT CONCAT(STRING_AGG(''+CAST(OT.TASK_NAME AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(COALESCE(OCAD.[ROWSREJECTED],0) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.START_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+''+CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,OTR.END_DATETIME,126),'T',' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+'','') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OTR.START_DATETIME), '') FROM OM.OM_TASKS OT LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR ON OTR.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2025-03-17' AS DATE) AND OTR.CREATE_DATETIME >= '2025-06-02T13:38:30.830' LEFT JOIN OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD ON OT.TASK_NAME = OCAD.TASK_NAME AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = CAST('2025-03-17' AS DATE) AND OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME BETWEEN OTR.START_DATETIME AND OTR.END_DATETIME LEFT JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID WHERE OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'TRU' select * from OM.OM_TASKS ot WHERE OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'TRU'
